lede: The most consequential thing on this week's government calendar is the Gondola Leadership Committee meeting on July 28, where the agenda includes an action item on background and history, a walkthrough of the Capital Investment Grant program and its funding commitments, and a project update — the kind of session where real money and long-term decisions start taking shape. Town Council also convenes July 27 as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's special event permit for its Live at the Drive show at 207 N Pine Street on July 30. On the community side, the week has plenty going on, from The Music Man at the Sheridan to Shakespeare in the Park and the Farmers Market.

notable.stake: Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit — July 30 event.
Action items on gondola history and CIG funding commitments could shape capital decisions.
